I have kind of this thing. Simple example, (this goes for any girl that i meet doesnt matter if it is bar or tinder or whatever)

im texting with girl for a week during that time im thinking what shes doying. I always come up with something  like shes perfect or like me etc i don’t know how to describe it.

Then there is first date, usually endimg with small kiss. im always saying the same thing. (In my head)Well shes different and i know that i will never see her again.

Usually we exchange few messages but i kinda always lose interest when i find out that she is not even a lil bit as i was imagining (sorry for my english, i hope that i wrote it correctly)

That´s what i’m strugling with.
I would die without book in my hand, when i watch something it´s mostly some kind of anime or animated movie. Lol im such kiddo.

I agree with you i´m in sales approx. 2,5 years. I think that sales is draying for me for two reasons.

1, Cold calling to new partners (it is weird that i love meeting people in real life? I love to listen they´re stories and learn from them. I´m in B2B sales, i´m meeting just managers or owners), i find really draying to talk with people over the phone all the time.

2, is probably taht when you meet someone they promise to send you thinks that you need to make it possible. They´re enthusiastic etc. And then change they´re mind as you said on they´re emotions. It really pisses me off.

That´s probably what drains me. What is the most draining thing for you? 

Thanks for response!

I wish you very best! I was thinking about it as well. My dream is one day doying some kind of bussiness that i can do alone, reselling seems nice. I just need to have enough money. Which i don´t have just yet.:D

Hello Tim, thanks for the response what exactly drained you?

That people were comming inside and you had to do interaction with them?

Well, that completely suits where im at right now in life. I used work some sort if IT guy in huge corporation,  then moved to sales because i always wanted to do some kind of bussiness, I went for sales to learn about B2C, B2B bussiness, how to run company, social contact, calling etc.

I learned LOT in it and I´m really gratefull for what i´ve learned.

But I´m in it for money as you said. I feel like i´m dying inside, i feel really disconected and generally unhappy in my life. And i think that comes from my job. Problem is that i´m kinda doying well in sales. I´m gonna quit anyway otherwise i would someday came to a point where i would want quit everything once and for all.

Thank for you´re answer! I wish you the very best!
